See bd-01KZXW5MFZGEXVJ3CMKMGBGFZX before certifying on this suite. The known-metric MC test now sits 1% below its own variance gate because replications dropped 120 to 64 while the pinned standard errors stayed at values measured at 120. It also applies a 2.7-sigma bias gate rather than the intended 4-sigma. Both from the same cause. Cheap fix is to pin the per-replication SD and divide by sqrt(replications) inside the test, so the constants stop depending on the replication count.

Also relevant to this epic: the 500-replication policy study Epic 7 closed on lives in benchmarks/run-learned-metric-policy-validation.R, not in the test suite. That is reasonable for a slow study, but it means the statistical evidence behind the Epic 7 conclusion is not exercised by test_local() or R CMD check - the same structural situation as bd-01KZXEFHAWJ97VCRJ84JP85GA8. If Epic 9 certifies the policy conclusion, it should record that the study is a benchmark artifact and state when it was last run.
